If your data is skewed, use the median, not the average or mode.

Standard Deviation
Large SD, means the data is more spread out.
Small SD, means the data is clustered near the mean
Zero SD, means there is no variation in the data
You cannot calculate the SD for a descrete variable.


Median and node are not affected by outliers
